hooks.command: jq -r 'if (.tool_input.command | test("git commit")) then "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"CHANGELOG.md must be updated and version bumped. (1) Add entry under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md. (2) Bump backend/VERSION and frontend/package.json: patch (x.y.Z+1) for bug fixes; minor (x.Y+1.0) for new features or new DB columns; major (X+1.0.0) for breaking auth/schema changes. Both files must stay in sync. (3) If new provider-facing features were added, update MANUAL.md under the relevant heading. If new admin-facing features were added, update ADMIN_GUIDE.md. Use plain English, task-oriented prose.\"}}" else "" end'
